title: Enhancing millet-based analogue rice through sustainable cold plasma treatment: effects on mineral composition, structural, textural, cooking, and rheological properties
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,1057-1072
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00413F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
S. Ganga Kishore, Madhuresh Dwivedi, R. Rahul, J. Deepa, G. Jeevarathinam, K. Kamaleeswari, Gitanjali Jothiprakash, Abinaya Veluswamy
Cold plasma, a sustainable technique, significantly enhanced the cooking and functional properties of millet-based analogue rice by improving its morphology, texture, and rheological behaviour, thereby strengthening its structural integrity.
